metadata.title: Pinching a free normal cover: variable critical exponent in reduced quasiconformal Teichmuller space
metadata.description: Anonymous, AI-assisted, unrefereed all-Fuchsian strengthening candidate related to AIM Problem 4.3. A fixed free normal cover gives all-Fuchsian points in one reduced quasiconformal Teichmuller space whose critical exponents take infinitely many values, with 1-delta=O_g(ell) along the stated pinching family. Under a broad group-deformation reading, Astala--Zinsmeister (1995) appears already to give an affirmative existential precedent; this is a direct AIM solution candidate only under the reduced surface-based reading. Candidate publication does not imply independent reconstruction, specialist validation, formal verification, peer review, historical priority, or endorsement.
